paper: WETW: Learning Pair-Specific Weighted Euclidean Distances for Efficient DTW Search
purpose: Saved numeric evidence behind every figure and table of the paper's experimental evaluation; redrawing it is not a fresh experiment.
scalability: AudioMNIST, 2K training series, database 3.25K-26K, length 1K-48K, warping window 1%-20%

figures.fig_e2e_mean: Figure 1, mean recall@10 versus seconds per query (geometric mean) over the eight collections
figures.fig_amnist: Figure 6, AudioMNIST scalability at a 2% shortlist
figures.fig_trainsize: Figure 7, recall@10 and training-set size versus preprocessing and training cost

tables.table_lower_bound_survival.tex: Table II, candidates reaching the DTW stage with LB_Keogh or LB_Webb alone
tables.table_offline_cost.tex: Table III, DTW-target and training cost, search time saved per query and break-even
tables.table_heads.tex: Table IV, distance functions on frozen WESee embeddings (regression only)
tables.table_direct_mlp.tex: Table V, WETW versus a direct MLP in WETW-FV
tables.table_components.tex: Table VI, objective ablations for every encoder
tables.table_architecture_capacity_matched.tex: Table VII, temporal branch ablation at matched capacity

Figures 1 and 5 (wetwfv = WETW-FV; exact = UCR Suite; lbk, lbw = single lower bounds; messi = MESSI-DTW; ds<g> = downsampled DTW with PAA factor g; cdps, ldps, neuts, rfdtan_wd = learned baselines) and Table II
evidence.end_to_end/kappa_selection.json: prefilter ratio kappa chosen on validation for every collection and shortlist fraction
evidence.main_models/<collection>.json: validation and test recall of the main WETW-FV models for every kappa and shortlist fraction
evidence.seeds/: training seeds 43 and 44 of every main model and the three-seed summary
evidence.scalability_controls/: Figure 6 exact searches and downsampled DTW
evidence.training_size/: Figure 7 subsets, epochs, shortlist fractions and costs
evidence.heads/, static_controls/: Table IV and the WESee L_WD column of Table VI

timing: Query times use one CPU thread per query on AMD EPYC 7543 nodes (evidence/end_to_end/hardware_audit.json) and include query encoding, database scoring, shortlist selection and exact verification with the UCR-Suite cascade and EAPrunedDTW.
NeuralWarp scores on an A100 GPU; Figure 6 NeuralWarp scoring measured on an H100 is multiplied by 1.10 to report A100-equivalent time.
Figure 6 learned-baseline scoring time is measured at L=4,000 on AudioMNIST-DS and scaled linearly with series length and database size; their verification time is measured at every setting.
Figure 7 training costs include pair-count estimates and H100-to-A100 scaling.

pretrained.collections: pretrained/<collection>.pt, Figures 1 and 5; kappa per shortlist fraction
pretrained.contents: ranking-refined encoder (stage iii) + validation-selected refined generator + configuration + kappa
